app.name: NikuCue
onboarding.title: Small wins, with a little cat.
onboarding.intro: I'm {catName}. Let's celebrate the little wins.
onboarding.demoNote: This is a demo. It will not add a habit record.
onboarding.nameTitle: What would you like to call your cat?
onboarding.nameHelp: You can change the name later.
onboarding.habitHelp: Start with something that feels right for you.
onboarding.reminderTitle: A time to check in with your cat?
onboarding.reminderHelp: Choose days and times. Reminders are optional.
home.noneHelp: A quiet moment with your cat is welcome too.
habit.name: Habit name
habit.archiveHelp: History is kept. You can choose Rest today for today.
habit.limit: You can have up to five active habits.
habit.limitHelp: Archiving frees a slot tomorrow. Extra slots are not sold.
habit.deleteTitle: Delete this habit and its records?
history.title: Our little wins
history.editHelp: You can edit the last seven days, including today.
settings.reduceMotionHelp: Your iPhone’s Reduce Motion setting also applies.
settings.deleteAllTitle: Delete cat settings and all local records?
settings.deleteAllBody: This cannot be undone. Your ad-removal purchase is kept.
settings.diagnosticsHelp: Off by default. Nothing is sent automatically.
reminder.limit: You can set up to two reminder times.
reminder.scheduleNote: Reminders follow your chosen days and times, even if you have already recorded today.
reminder.systemNote: Delivery may be affected by Focus and other iPhone settings.
reminder.denied: You can allow notifications in iPhone Settings.
reminder.duplicate: A reminder already uses these days and this time.
reminder.notificationBody: A moment to notice today’s little wins.
purchase.title: Remove ads
purchase.subtitle: One-time purchase. Keep your time with the cat ad-free.
purchase.sameFeatures: Cat and habit features are the same in the free version.
purchase.pending: Your purchase is awaiting approval. You can keep using the app.
purchase.noneFound: No purchase was found to restore.
purchase.restoreHelp: Use the Apple Account used for the purchase. Restoring may need a connection.
purchase.error: We could not verify the purchase information. Please try again.
purchase.unverified: The purchase could not be verified. Ad removal has not been applied.
ads.label: Advertisement
backup.warning: Backups are not encrypted and contain habit names and records. Choose the destination carefully.
backup.replaceBody: This overwrites current records. Exporting a backup first is recommended.
backup.restored: Imported. Reminders are off; enable them again as needed.
backup.invalid: This backup cannot be imported. Your existing data is unchanged.
backup.tooLarge: The file is too large. Choose a backup of 5 MB or less.
privacy.summary: Habits and records are stored on your device. Ads, purchases and purchase restoration use network services.
privacy.backup: Manual backups are exported to a destination you choose.
privacy.ads: Ad services may process device and advertising information. See the privacy policy for details.
error.save: Could not save. Your record has not changed. Please try again.
error.database: Could not open your data. It has not been deleted.
error.notification: Could not schedule reminders. Please try again.
error.unscheduled: This habit is not scheduled for this day.
error.editWindow: You can edit only the last seven days, including today.
reaction.greet.1: I'm glad you're here. Your pace is just fine.
reaction.greet.2: Let's spend a little moment together.
reaction.return.2: Welcome back. We can start from here.
reaction.pet.2: Can I stay close a little longer?
reaction.complete.1: One little win. I'm happy with you.
reaction.complete.3: A small step is still a step.
reaction.complete.4: You did it. Little by little is enough.
reaction.water.2: You made a moment for some water.
reaction.stretch.1: A little movement. I’ll stretch too.
reaction.read.1: You made time to read. I’ll sit quietly nearby.
reaction.read.2: A little time with a book.
reaction.tidy.1: A little tidying, a little fresh start.
reaction.rest.3: A little rest. Let’s relax here together.
reaction.allDone.1: Everything for today is done. Time for a little rest.
reaction.allDone.2: Today’s little wins are all here.
reaction.resolved.1: Today is recorded. Let’s take it easy.
reaction.milestone.3: Three days with little wins together.
reaction.milestone.7: Seven days with little wins. They add up, little by little.
reaction.milestone.14: Fourteen days with little wins together. That makes me happy.
reaction.cheer.2: Whatever feels possible, at your own pace.
reaction.doze.1: A little sleepy… still here with you.
